title: Independently audit the rank-seven coefficient-capacity claim
body:
## Summary

Independently corroborate PR3090 at `47a2bcec53667f490df6d40550e14a8ae465cba4`, adding only `research/rank7-scalar-microstates/`.

```text
literal native scalar/warp stream
  Fraction propagation and recipe execution
  separately implemented integer original-row and serialized-recipe execution
    equal every-prefix digests
    all twelve PR3090 recipe/census/capacity comparisons agree
```

No defect was found in the checked arithmetic scope. The inherited 7,072-real-instruction-slot saving fits the same conditional 84-bit common format. This is additional verification, not a new construction or kappa claim.

PR3090's coefficient engines share normalized macro-row propagation. This audit's integer engine starts from all 632 original input columns and independently propagates that stream. A two-macro fixture forbids calling the shared propagation helper. The native compiler, generic PR3078 recipes and PR3089 frame theorem remain reused, not independently verified.

The work initially took PR3089's released handoff. A submission refresh found concurrent PR3090, so the construction scope was narrowed to this corroboration. PR3090 retains its construction credit. [Proof, exact sources, evidence, reproduction and limits](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/764123a9e18c9a838aee917af7657aa639804680/research/rank7-scalar-microstates). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18984607).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the existing arithmetic check shares per-macro normalized inputs between its coefficient engines.
  **After:** independent integer original-row propagation plus serialized instruction replay agrees on every changed recipe prefix. All twelve exact recipe hashes, macro/instruction counts, source writes, scratch-using counts and scalar/combined capacities match the pinned claim.
- Seventeen behavioral groups pass, including incorrect HALF, missing source restoration/clear, endpoint-correct hidden grid/overflow, corrupted claims and source corruption. Registered Python 3.12 replay passes; optimized Python 3.13 and read-only Git-free export outputs are byte-identical. Ruff correctness/formatting, warning-as-error compilation and all 41 publication-byte checks pass locally. All 25 reused files authenticate against exact SHA-256 and Git blob identities. Hosted CI and independent human review are separate.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-scalar-microstates`. The README supplies external-output commands. Scientific main is `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6, unchanged at submission refresh.

Credit PR3090/3089/3078 and the retained PR3076/3060/3056/3042/3015/2979/2226 native, geometry and owner lineage. Frozen notices are unchanged. Development used substantial automated assistance. No independent human review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

One opt-in audit package. Adapter endpoints remain hypotheses; adapter interiors, physical operations/clean scratch/routing, recursive approximation, later consumer and complete invoice remain open. No shared compiler, selected frontier or frozen predecessor changes.
